hero.title: GREYGOOSE
hero.desc: Seven college friends who take parties too seriously and everything else not seriously enough. Everyone has a file. Open one.

crews.name: The Founders
crews.blurb: The three who started it in a dorm common room with one speaker and bad ideas. Still sign off on every guest list.

crews.name: The Regulars
crews.blurb: First to arrive, last to leave, know where the spare key is. The reason the group chat never sleeps.

crews.name: The Wildcards
crews.blurb: Unpredictable attendance, guaranteed stories. Invite them and something will happen.

members.name: Soham Garg
members.blurb: Started the group chat that became greygoose. Runs the calendar, the playlist, and the spreadsheet nobody else will admit they check.

members.name: Arnav Jindal

record.Catchphrase: It'll look better if we move the couch.

members.blurb: Turns a room into a venue in twenty minutes. If the party has a floor plan, Maya drew it on the back of a receipt.

members.name: Diego Salas

record.Most likely to: Have a folding table in his trunk

members.blurb: Keeps the whole operation solvent. Books the venue, splits the tab, and somehow always finds the cheaper option.

members.name: Priya Nair

record.Undefeated at: Getting everyone to look at once
record.Most likely to: Post the recap before you're home

members.blurb: The reason there is any proof these nights happened. Shoots on a point-and-shoot from 2004 and cuts the recap by breakfast.

members.name: Tom Becker

record.Catchphrase: I got it, I got it.

members.blurb: The one who makes it look easy the next morning. First on the cleanup, never asked twice.

members.name: Kai Zhou

record.Most likely to: Vanish at 11, reappear with a better speaker

members.blurb: Shows up half the time and runs the back half of the night when he does. The set nobody planned is usually the best one.

members.name: Robbie Dunne

record.Most likely to: Turn a Tuesday into a road trip

members.blurb: The reason for at least three group legends. Attendance optional, chaos included.

parties.name: Rooftop V

record.House rule: Shoes off on the good rug

parties.blurb: Fifth edition of the one that started it. Come early, the roof fills up fast and Diego actually counts.

payment.note: Covers the bar, the sound and the roof.

parties.name: Friendsgiving

record.Theme: Bring a dish or bring a story
record.House rule: One toast each, keep it short

parties.blurb: The sit-down one. Phones in a bowl, everyone cooks something, Diego does the math on the turkey.

payment.note: Covers the food. Bring nothing but yourself.

parties.name: Lake Day

record.MVP: Tom, who remembered sunscreen for everyone

parties.blurb: Left at 7am in three cars. Came back sunburnt and quiet. Universally agreed to be a top-three greygoose day.

parties.name: The First One

record.Theme: We didn't know to have one

parties.blurb: Where greygoose started. Twenty-five people, one playlist, and the group chat that never got muted after.

access.title: Answer this
access.intro: This web-page is not public. Answer one thing only the group would know. One word only.

questions.question: What is the second name of Adhyan?
who is the kind of dc?
who is the sister of arnav?

joinForm.title: YOUR FILE
joinForm.intro: Fill this in and you get your own file in the archive. Skip anything you would rather not answer — blanks simply do not show up.
joinForm.doneText: Your file is with the group now. It shows up once someone waves it through.
